definition.simple: A change in the direction of a trend: the old structure breaks and a new one forms.
definition.balanced: An uptrend reverses when price breaks below its last higher low and then makes lower highs and lower lows. You only know afterwards, and a new trend can turn again. Every reversal starts out looking like a [[pullback]].

example: Uptrend low 4,580 breaks with a close at 4,560; then a lower high at 4,650 and a lower low at 4,540.
